rows.role_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of India (Marxist)
rows.text: The party reports that its Central Committee, 'now in session in New Delhi, has decided that Comrade Prakash Karat will be the coordinator of the Polit Bureau and the Central Committee, as an interim arrangement until the 24th Party Congress to be held in April 2025 at Madurai', a decision taken 'due to the sad and sudden demise of the sitting General Secretary of the CPI(M), Comrade Sitaram Yechury'.
